sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate defines the required ship-owned cross-owner path from the ship to each represented UIWL waterline's displacement.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: waterlineDisplacement is placed on each iceWaterline node, but its authoritative requiredOwner is ship. The UIWL greatest-displacement selection must use a canonical ship-owned cross-owner path for each represented UIWL waterline's displacement; do not relocate the property arbitrarily.
